title: Deaf and Hard of Hearing Access to Intelligent Personal Assistants: Comparison of Voice-Based Options with an LLM-Powered Touch Interface
reasoning: The paper focuses on the accessibility and usability of intelligent personal assistants for Deaf and Hard of Hearing users through an empirical mixed-methods study. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, theology, epistemology, hermeneutics, morals, or ethics.
